landing.badge: AI for a More Inclusive World
landing.support: Detect cultural inconsistencies, assess safety risks, identify potential harmful stereotypes, and support responsible AI with transparent, reviewable analysis.
landing.platformTitle: Focused tools for culturally aware AI evaluation
landing.platformSubtitle: A clean evaluation workflow for researchers and product teams—without turning model output into cultural truth.
landing.featureCulturalDesc: Review architecture, clothing, objects, language, geography, and social context with confidence and uncertainty.
landing.featureSafetyDesc: Structured content-safety categories with confidence, explanation, and review recommendations.
landing.featureBiasDesc: Surface potential stereotype indicators and representational concerns with evidence and context.
landing.featureReviewDesc: Keep human oversight available for uncertain or high-impact cases.
landing.featureReportsDesc: Present scores, confidence, evidence, explanation, and recommendations in one workspace.
landing.howTitle: From Arabic prompt and image to a reviewable result
landing.howDesc: CulturalGuard keeps semantic alignment, cultural context, safety, and bias signals separate, then aggregates them with transparent confidence and review guidance.
landing.stepUploadDesc: Provide an AI-generated image and Arabic prompt.
landing.stepEvaluateDesc: Run semantic, cultural, safety, and bias analysis.
landing.stepReviewDesc: Inspect evidence, confidence, uncertainty, and recommendations.
landing.stepHistoryDesc: Keep completed evaluations available in your history.
landing.ctaKicker: Build more culturally aware, safer AI
landing.ctaTitle: One image at a time, with evidence and human oversight.
landing.footer: Live evaluations use the configured AI provider. No preset benchmark, customer, or accuracy claims are shown.
landing.liveDisclaimer: Scores appear only after a real evaluation runs against your uploaded image and prompt.

evaluate.title: New Evaluation
evaluate.subtitle: Evaluate an AI-generated image against an Arabic prompt with transparent, reviewable signals.
evaluate.inputDesc: Upload an image and provide the Arabic prompt used to generate it.

evaluate.missingImage: Please upload an image before running an evaluation.
evaluate.readyDesc: Your result will appear here without leaving this page.
evaluate.workflowDesc: Validation → Arabic processing → image analysis → similarity → cultural context → safety → bias → aggregation.
evaluate.processingDesc: The backend is validating and analyzing the image. Keep this page open.
evaluate.resultSubtitle: Automated scores are probabilistic signals—not absolute cultural truth.
evaluate.noElevated: No elevated findings are present in this evaluation. Human review may still be appropriate in high-impact contexts.
evaluate.reviewDesc: Add a reviewer decision without leaving the evaluation workspace.
evaluate.commentPlaceholder: Add evidence, context, correction, or rationale…
evaluate.reviewSaved: Review saved to the audit trail.
evaluate.promptPlaceholder: Paste the actual Arabic prompt used to generate the image…
evaluate.providerSetupHint: Add GEMINI_API_KEY to the project .env file. The free-tier Gemini endpoint and model are already configured by default.
evaluate.providerMissing: Add your own free-tier Gemini API key to enable live evaluation.
evaluate.liveNote: Results come only from Google Gemini and your actual uploaded image and Arabic prompt. No demo scores are generated.
